items.source: Adds a RepositoryMethodInvocationListener to the factory to plug in functionality triggered right after running query methods and fragment methods.

items.source: Factory bean to create instances of a given repository interface. Creates a proxy implementing the configured repository interface and apply an advice handing the control to the QueryExecutorMethodInterceptor. Query detection strategy can be configured by setting QueryLookupStrategy.Key.
items.translation: 工厂 Bean 用于创建给定仓库接口的实例。它创建一个实现了配置的仓库接口的代理，并应用一个 Advice，将控制权交给 `QueryExecutorMethodInterceptor`。查询检测策略可以通过设置 QueryLookupStrategy.Key 进行配置。

items.source: Configures the repository base class to use when creating the repository. If not set, the factory will use the type returned by getRepositoryBaseClass(RepositoryMetadata) by default.
items.translation: 配置创建仓库时要使用的仓库基类。如果未设置，工厂将默认使用getRepositoryBaseClass(RepositoryMetadata)方法返回的类型。

items.source: Returns a repository instance for the given interface backed by a single instance providing implementation logic for custom logic. For more advanced composition needs use getRepository(Class, RepositoryFragments).
items.translation: 返回一个由单个实例提供实现逻辑的仓库实例，该实例支持给定接口并针对自定义逻辑。对于更高级的组合需求，请使用 getRepository(Class, RepositoryFragments)。
